title: Haaye Hussain Haaye Hussain
body:
Haye Hussain haaye Hussain haye Hussain
Kehti hai hawayein karbal ki
Haye Hussain……haye Hussain…… mazloom musafir ibne Ali
Haye Hussain……haye Hussain…… dilbar tera ham shakle nabi, ummid thi jisse laila ki
Sine mein lagi uske barchi phir tune uthayi laash uski
Tanhaayi mein ghurbat teri, mazloom musfir ibne Ali
<<MINI>>
Mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Hussain……haye Hussain…… Zainab key dono pyase pisar, abdullah key the Noor-e-nazar
They aun-o-mohammed khoon mein tar
Mazloomi teri un laashao par
Wo sabr tera wo bechaini, mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<MINI>>
Mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Hussain……haye Hussain…… maidan ko gaye Qasim dulha, aur uska badan paamal hua
Sarpeet key kehti thi farwa
Kubra ko mile kaise pursa
Kuch dair ki dulhan bewa hui, mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<MINI>>
Mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Hussain……haye Hussain…… haatao pa tere Asghar tha, besheer tha kis darjah pyaasa
Ek teer jo gardan par aya
Shashmaahe ka jab manka dhala
Kya jaane tere dil par guzri, mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<MINI>>
Mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Hussain……haye Hussain…… ghazi par zulm hue kitne, sar zakhmi tha bazu the kaate
Abbas gire jab ghode se
Tab tooti kamar ko thame hue
Tha nouha tera bhaai bhaai, mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<MINI>>
Mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Hussain……haye Hussain…… mazloomi teri zehra key pisar, aankhe teri zaqmi manzar
Har simt se naize our phattar
Tu jhoom raha tha ghode par
Maqtal mein fughaan thi zehra ki, mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<MINI>>
Mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Hussain……haye Hussain…… Asghar ko tune dafn kiya, dil thaam key baano ne dekha
Jhule wala dafnaya gaya phir taza sitam Asghar pe hue
Wo nanha sir naize ki ani, mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<MINI>>
Mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Hussain……haye Hussain…… karte hi rahengey ham matam, haatao mein liye ghazi ka alam
Lehrayengey haq ka parcham
Royengey rasheed is gham mein hum
Aur lab pe rahega nouha yehi, mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<MINI>>
Mazloom musafir ibne Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Hussain……haye Hussain……
